events.title: MTV Launches with Buggles
events.blurb: MTV launched on this day with the Buggles' Video Killed The Radio Star as its first music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: 35 years ago, MTV changed the music landscape with its launch and the first video, Buggles' Video Killed The Radio Star. What's your favorite 80s music video?

events.title: Oasis Release Definitely Maybe
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album Definitely Maybe on this day in 1994.

angles.name: Oasis Debut
angles.copy: Oasis released their debut album Definitely Maybe 32 years ago, an album that helped shape the Britpop era. What's your favorite track from the album?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Took Place
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Festival took place on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock Anniversary
angles.copy: 57 years ago, the iconic Woodstock Festival took place, a pivotal moment in music history. What's your favorite performance from the festival?

events.title: Anniversary of Elvis' Death
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: We remember the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away 49 years ago. His music lives on, what's your favorite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur Shot Dead

angles.name: Tupac Shakur Tribute
angles.copy: 30 years ago, Tupac Shakur was tragically taken from us, but his music and legacy live on. What's your favorite Tupac track?

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
